graphics: Poppler pdftocairo required; actual version is recorded in run_manifest.json. R creates vector PDF, Poppler creates SVG and PNG from that same PDF without X11.
installation: Optional --install builds pinned sources in the workflow cache library; requires R build tools including a Fortran compiler for statmod. No global R library changes.
portability: R, BLAS, graphics devices and operating system are recorded in sessionInfo.txt. Package sources are fixed; the complete operating system is not containerized. Figures can differ in font rendering across platforms.
